request.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn the ship into a floating iceberg fortress: hull, masts and sails become one chunky jagged iceberg of packed white snow and pale ice with bright ice-blue crystal faces, wide at the waterline, rising to two peaks; on top a small dark brown-grey hide tent with a white fur banner, and two tiny hunters in cream fur hoods peeking over an ice wall. No wood, no sails. Keep the size, black outline and style; no water, transparent background.
